_comment: Documentation-sync policy for aguayluz-pr (thehub-pr ADR 0010). Read by tools/check_docs_sync.py. couplings: when a covered path changes, the doc must change in the same diff, or the commit/PR says 'Docs-Impact: none - <reason>'. Seeded conservatively: each coupling was replayed over this repo's recent human-authored changes. All but one never fired; README <- scripts/ingest_*.py (add) would have flagged 2 of 26, both new data sources the README's Real-data status never mentions, so it is the first to drop if it proves noisy. Add couplings for docs that enumerate things; do not add ones that fire on routine work.

couplings.why: 'Desktop app' lists one double-click launcher per platform.
'Real-data status' enumerates the ingest scripts and the data each one brings in; deleting or renaming a named one is already caught by the reference check.
'Run' tells contributors to run the validation gates with this script, inside a code block that the reference check does not read.
States how many sector modules exist and lists them; the modules are defined in this file.
'Repository files' lists the parity manifest, baseline, detector, tests and gate.
